slug: 2025-09-15 Kenya developing DPI roadmap to streamline public service delivery

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that the National AI Strategy 2025-2030, the DPI roadmap under development and a planned National Data Governance policy are all part of the Kenya National Digital Masterplan 2022-2032; the report gives no event date for the plan, so its published date, 2025-09-15, is used, and it does not say whether the plan's text is public.

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and Digital Economy

note: The Masterplan is named with a period and as the umbrella of three thematic instruments, but its own scope across economy and state is not described, so class is left empty.
